overloadMerges.note: The docs render two syntax lines that differ only in whether the leading '*' is passed (selecting whether 'object' is an object-name string vs. a form variable reference). That's one semantic overload with an optional literal-symbol discriminator, not two independent overloads.

params.description: If present, object is a form object name (string); if omitted, object is a variable reference.

params.name: object
params.description: Form object name (if * is passed) or variable reference (if * is omitted), designating the target list box, column, header, or footer.

params.name: row
params.description: Row (or, when object is a column, cell) number whose color is requested.

params.name: colorType
params.default: font color (lk font color) if omitted
params.description: Constant (lk background color or lk font color, List Box theme) selecting which color to read/write.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Returns the font or background color of a row or cell in an array-type list box, as a CSS color string.

constraints: Only works with array-type list boxes; use OBJECT SET RGB COLORS for the 4-byte longint color format instead.
